summary: Signing in saved the new session before the server had bound its account, so the app showed the person signed in while it still ran on the device's guest data; when the account arrived seconds later the app rebuilt under it and dropped what they had done meanwhile (a space hosted, a search typed), failing the production critical journeys. Fixed by keeping a new sign-in pending until its account is bound, then saving account and session together, with the sign-in modal on "Signing in…" until then.
